title: Subscription to the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development
what_it_is: Subscription to the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development

sections.label: IBRD subscription increase
sections.summary: Parliament previously raised the IBRD subscription threshold in 2014, and Singapore now proposes fully subscribing to 1,540 shares from the 2018 capital increase.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: In 2014, Parliament raised the threshold for our cumulative subscription to IBRD for the first time since 1966 to US$672 million.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: We now propose to fully subscribe to the 1,540 shares allotted to Singapore in the 2018 IBRD capital increase exercise.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: This amounts to close to US$186 million, which will bring our cumulative subscription since 1966 to about US$858 million.

sections.label: IDA subscription and contribution
sections.summary: Parliament raised Singapore's IDA subscription threshold in 2016, and Singapore now proposes contributing up to US$70 million over three years for IDA19.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: In 2016, Parliament raised the threshold for Singapore's IDA subscription to US$1.1 million to enable our IDA18 contributions, up from the earlier US$1 million stipulated by section 4(2) of the IDA Act.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: We now propose to contribute up to US$70 million over three years for IDA19, which will bring our subscription component to up to US$1.3 million.

sections.label: Total World Bank Group outlay
sections.summary: The fiscal outlay to the World Bank Group's capital raising exercises totals about US$92 million for IBRD and IDA, plus about US$7.5 million for IFC.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: In total, therefore, our fiscal outlay to the World Bank Group's capital raising exercises will amount to about US$92 million for IBRD and IDA, and an additional about US$7.5 million for the IFC subscription.

sections.label: Singapore's IBRD loans since 1966
sections.summary: Singapore joined IBRD in 1966 and subsequently received 12 loans for infrastructure projects including port expansion, telecommunications, DBS capitalisation and NUS campus construction.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: In 1966, Singapore joined IBRD and subsequently received 12 loans from the bank for a variety of infrastructure projects – from port expansion and telecommunications to the capitalisation of then-Development Bank of Singapore and the construction of the National University of Singapore campus.

sections.label: IFC private capital mobilisation
sections.summary: In FY2018 IFC mobilised over US$1.5 billion in private capital for Asia Pacific, three-quarters with Singapore-based banks and financial institutions, strengthening Singapore's financial and infrastructure hub status.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: In FY2018, IFC mobilised more than US$1.5 billion in private capital for the Asia Pacific region, three-quarters of which was done with the participation of Singapore-based banks and financial institutions.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: This has strengthened Singapore's status as a regional financial hub.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Singapore companies and services have also benefited from the World Bank Group's advisory, project preparation, structuring and financing activities in the region.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: These activities add to the vibrancy of Singapore's infrastructure ecosystem and reinforce our position as a major infrastructure hub for Asia, creating opportunities for our businesses and our people.
